title: Scaena bundle manifest
description: `manifest.json` (SPEC §3.1): what a bundle held when it was last saved. Saving writes it; nothing in the render path reads it.

scaena.description: The deck format version the bundle was saved in.

files.description: Every other file in the bundle, by its path in the bundle: its sha256.

created.description: When the bundle was first saved.
